title: Agent runtime
description: Architect, developer and reviewer run as separate phases with deterministic verification in between. Pick a provider per role; everything else has a working default.
loadFailed: Could not load runtime settings. Retry before making changes.
enabled: Use the agent runtime for implementation
enableHint: Saving does not start agents. Implementations of this project use the runtime once enabled; disabled projects keep their current execution mode.
unavailable: This Core installation does not include the agent runtime. Update Core before enabling it; you can prepare settings while disabled.
approvalBeforeArchive: Pause for approval before completing the workflow

providers.title: Providers
providers.hint: CLI providers use their existing login. API providers accept an environment variable name only, never an API key. Local endpoints can leave it blank. Assign another provider to a role before removing its current provider.

agents.title: Role assignments
agents.hint: Each role runs its own provider session. Leave the model on its default unless you need a specific one. Turns are the number of tool calls a role may make (default {{turns}}).

limits.title: Workflow limits
limits.hint: Empty fields use Core defaults: {{attempts}} developer attempts and {{minutes}} minutes per workflow. Token and USD caps are optional; USD caps require Claude for every AI role.

verification.title: Verification commands
verification.hint: Optional. These run after the developer finishes and their failures go back to the developer. Leave the list empty and the architect proposes the project's own checks on each run; repositories without any automated check are still reviewed.
verification.detected: Filled in from the checks this project already defines.
verification.nothingDetected: No test, type-check or build command was found. That is fine: the architect proposes checks at run time when possible.
verification.detectFailed: Could not inspect the project repositories.
verification.invalidLine: Verification command is empty or has an unterminated quote: {{line}}

runs.title: Saved executions
runs.hint: Continue in the original worktree with the frozen scope and settings; progress appears in that job's log. This does not publish or restart Desktop delivery. Active rail executions are stopped from their job controls.

roleHints.architect: Reads the code and writes the proposal, design, tasks and spec. Read-only.
roleHints.developer: Implements the tasks with tests. Can edit files and run commands inside the CLI sandbox.
roleHints.reviewer: Checks the result against the spec and the verification evidence. Read-only.
